items.name: c-sidebar-1
items.title: Application shell with a workspace switcher
items.description: Grouped navigation with count badges, row menus and a footer account menu.
items.descriptionLong: Application shell with a workspace switcher. Built by composing Avatar, Breadcrumb, Button, Card, Dropdown Menu and 1 more. Uses cn alongside the shadcn primitives. A free, open source shadcn sidebar example you can install with npx shadcn@latest add @reui/c-sidebar-1 and edit as your own code.

items.name: c-sidebar-2
items.title: Icon rail that collapses
items.description: Labels give way to tooltips at 3rem, with a rail and a trigger to drive it.
items.descriptionLong: Icon rail that collapses. Built by composing Avatar, Button, Sidebar, Tooltip. Uses cn alongside the shadcn primitives. A free, open source shadcn sidebar example you can install with npx shadcn@latest add @reui/c-sidebar-2 and edit as your own code.

items.name: c-sidebar-3
items.title: Documentation nav with sub-menus
items.description: A search field, sections that collapse and a sub-tree under the current page.
items.descriptionLong: Documentation nav with sub-menus. Built by composing Collapsible, Sidebar. Uses cn alongside the shadcn primitives. A free, open source shadcn sidebar example you can install with npx shadcn@latest add @reui/c-sidebar-3 and edit as your own code.

items.name: c-sidebar-4
items.title: Right-hand inspector panel
items.description: A floating off-canvas panel with row actions, linked counts and a status badge.
items.descriptionLong: Right-hand inspector panel. Built by composing Avatar, Badge, Button, Dropdown Menu, Sidebar. A free, open source shadcn sidebar example you can install with npx shadcn@latest add @reui/c-sidebar-4 and edit as your own code.

items.name: c-sidebar-5
items.title: Filtering, loading and empty states
items.description: A filter field, skeleton rows while a refresh runs, and a real empty state.
